SHRI JAIRAM RAMESH (Andhra Pradesh): Sir, I thank you for 
allowing me to raise an issue of pr ofound national importance. This issue 
relates to the continuing tragedy of Eastern India, particularly in the States of

deaths; in 2004, there were 400 deaths and in 2005, so far, there are, at least,

Eastern U.P., Bihar, Jharkhand and West  Bengal. Sir, through this special 
notice, I do want to draw the attentio n of the Government that although we

people not only get afflicted, not only is there morbidity, but also there is 
mortality. Thank you, Sir.
